name: Asian Paints

snapshot.about: Beautify, transform, and preserve spaces through paints, coatings, waterproofing, bath, kitchen, and decor solutions.

narrative: Management delivered on volume growth expectations of 8% to 10%, achieving 9% in Q1 FY27 and 8% in H1 FY27. However, margins diverged, with consolidated EBITDA margin falling to 16.0% in Q2 FY27, below the 18% to 20% target band.

promises.statement: Management agrees that 5% to 6% value growth is a reasonable expectation.

said.quote: I think that is a reasonable take in terms of what we can look at

actual_source.source: screener.in, compiled from the company's filed results

promises.statement: Management expects volume growth to be between 8% and 10%.

said.quote: No, I think I have been maintaining that, as I said that, band of 8- 10% for volume and gap between the volume and the value is a good indicator

actual_source.quote: Overall, we are at about a strong 9% volume growth

promises.note: Volume growth reached 9% in Q1 FY27 and 8% in H1 FY27, meeting the 8-10% guidance.

promises.statement: Management guides to keep PBDIT margins within the 18% to 20% band.

said.quote: So, I would say that we would keep the guidance between that 18 and 20% band as we go ahead and that is something which we will endeavour to maintain

actual_source.source: screener.in, compiled from the company's filed results

promises.statement: Management expects high single-digit volume growth of 8% to 10% in FY27.

said.quote: we are still confident that demand conditions should continue giving us closer to high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8 -10%, as we predict going forward

actual_source.quote: Overall, we are at about a strong 9% volume growth

promises.note: H1 FY27 decorative volume grew 8%, keeping the full-year 8-10% guidance on track.

promises.statement: Total CapEx for the VAM and VAE plant facility is about Rs. 3,250 crores.

said.quote: Today we have got the phase 1 of it, out of the total CapEx of about Rs. 3,250 crores which is there

promises.statement: Management aims to maintain its PBDIT margin guidance range of 18% to 20%.

said.quote: Just to understand clearly that in doing so, you would like to maintain your margin guidance, which has always been 18-20%

promises.statement: Management expects reasonable decorative volume growth of 8% to 9% going forward.

said.quote: we feel that it would be reasonable to expect to see a volume growth of about 8% to 9% going forward

promises.statement: Management expects gross margin to remain within the 41% to 43% band.

said.quote: This band of about 41% to 43% would really be the band we should be looking forward to

cash.read: Profits reliably turn into cash. Over FY22–FY26, cumulative operating cash flow of ₹22,795 crore fully covered total reported net profit of ₹20,943 crore.

bull.point: Cumulative operating cash flow of ₹22,795 crore exceeded total reported profit of ₹20,943 crore over FY22–FY26.

evidence.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹22,795 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹20,943 crore.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bull.point: International business delivered rapid growth, achieving revenue expansion of 27% in Q1 FY27 and 30% in Q2 FY27.

evidence.quote: We have grown at about 27% in Q1
Both, quarter two is at about 30% growth and H1 at about 28% of what you are able to see

bull.point: Decorative business value growth accelerated strongly to 16.6% in Q1 FY27 and 14.5% in Q2 FY27.

evidence.quote: If you look at the value, the decorative value has grown at a very good pitch of about 16.6%, albeit on a lower base
the value growth has also been very strong at 14.5%

bear.point: Consolidated PBDIT margin fell to 15.6% in Q2 FY27, missing management's targeted 18% to 20% guidance band.

evidence.quote: We believe as we go forward, for the year we should be able to maintain the band of what we have spoken of 18% to 20%
The PBDIT margin is little bit lower at about 15.6%, lower by about 202 bps

bear.point: Competition Commission of India ordered an investigation into alleged abuse of dominant position hindering competitor entry in the decorative paints market.

evidence.quote: The CCI had passed a prima facie order dated 1st July 2025 directing the Director General (DG) to conduct an investigation against the Company

bear.point: Contingent liabilities for disputed tax matters and other claims rose to ₹488.74 crore as of March 31, 2026.
